requested_change: Require T10 and future T11+ FIX_REQUIRED repair candidates to provide the canonical source-bound C0R Repair Sufficiency report before builder_repair_gate can authorize implementation. Verify exact C0/plan hashes, ACCEPTED outcome, unchanged thresholds, full blocker coverage, and deterministic recomputation of the C0R report. Treat the canonical C0R record as bookkeeping only, never as causal implementation.
reason: The T10 canary proved that workflow-level C0R blocks insufficient repairs before expensive validation, but a workflow omission could still bypass it because builder_repair_gate does not independently require C0R. The builder gate must enforce the accepted repair idea and then separately enforce the actual bounded implementation.
dependency: Integrated non-voting C0R repair_sufficiency_critic.py and the existing canonical C0/REPAIR_PLAN repair lifecycle.
expected_behavior: T10+ repair plans without repair_sufficiency or without an exact canonical REPAIR_PLAN_ACCEPTED C0R report fail closed. Stale or forged C0R reports fail. T09 historical repair validation remains unchanged. C1-C11 authority and >9.0 thresholds remain unchanged.
tests_required: Exact recomputed C0R acceptance permits the bounded repair.
Forged or hand-edited C0R content rejects deterministic recomputation.
T09 historical repair remains backward compatible.
Architecture validator accepts only the exact bounded builder delta.
authorization: Authorize canonical C0R enforcement inside builder_repair_gate for T10 and future T11+ repairs, preserving all critics and thresholds.
forbidden_changes: No gameplay approval authority for C0R.
No C1-C11 score or threshold changes.
No weakening of builder diff/protected-file/repair-base/freeze checks.
No use of the C0R bookkeeping file as causal-touch credit.
No retroactive invalidation of completed T09.
